title: Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 6, 2026, announcing monthly distributions for March 2026 at an annualized rate of 5.00% of NAV across multiple share classes. The distributions were payable to stockholders of record as of March 31, 2026.
key_points: Company declared distributions for Class I, D, S, T, IX, AX, and TX shares plus operating partnership units
Gross distribution per share ranges from $0.06818 (Class TX) to $0.08536 (Class I and IX)
Annualized distribution rate is 5.00% of NAV for all share classes
Record date was March 31, 2026; payment date approximately April 6, 2026
Distributions may be paid in cash or reinvested via DRIP
Company notes distributions may be sourced from non-operating cash flow
